bug_info.bug_desc: For a write to pmpaddr[i], the merge-pre guard combines pmpcfg[i+1].L with pmpcfg[i].A. It can reject a legal write when the upper entry is locked but not TOR, and allow a write when the upper entry is locked in TOR mode but the current entry is not TOR.
bug_info.fix_hint: Evaluate both the lock bit and TOR address mode on pmpcfg[i+1], while retaining the independent lock check for entry i.
